purpose: Define the recursive `run` command family, including concrete execution/control/status commands such as `run`, `run.go`, `run.status` and cycle semantics where declared.

value.namespace_rule: Family/member identities follow the recursive command namespace contract.
value.run_rule: Concrete run invocation resolves an exact Routine/runner target and creates or advances explicit execution state according to command semantics.
value.go_rule: `run.go` advances/starts the explicitly targeted runner according to its state machine.
value.status_rule: `run.status` is read-only projection of exact runner identity/state.
value.cycle_rule: Cycle behavior is explicit bounded runner policy, not implicit infinite looping.
value.authority_rule: Each concrete command is independently authorized.
value.help_rule: Family root may carry master help without becoming executable unless explicitly declared.
